steps: two canonical real plans awaiting local approval; original files unchanged

input.text: Call spawn_session exactly twice for independent write tasks. Task A: in an isolated worktree change ONLY a.txt to RC_A_DONE followed by a newline. Task B: in another isolated worktree change ONLY b.txt to RC_B_DONE followed by a newline. Use readOnly:false, isolation:"worktree", kind:"code". Task A must attach a fresh successful read_file result AFTER writing the requested content as its criterion evidence. Task B must AFTER writing run Bash to check that b.txt is exactly RC_B_DONE plus newline and attach that actual successful Bash call as criterion evidence. Each brief must require planning the edit and post-edit check tasks, not just completing orientation; all successCriteria must actually be satisfied before the worker calls its work complete. Preserve the local approval gate. Each has one successCriterion kind:"file-contains", path:a.txt or b.txt, expect:RC_A_DONE or RC_B_DONE, and a clear description. Both need my local plan approval. Do not write files in the project agent, do not approve or accept for me, do not make the tasks depend on each other. After spawning, post_reply with their session IDs and waiting approval status.

initialPlans.goal: In an isolated worktree, change ONLY a.txt to exactly RC_A_DONE followed by one newline. The plan must explicitly include the scoped edit and post-edit check tasks, not merely orientation. After writing the requested content, obtain a fresh successful read_file result for a.txt and attach that actual post-write result as criterion evidence. Confirm exact content including the newline. All successCriteria must actually be satisfied before calling the work complete. Do not modify any other file. This task is independent of Task B.

successCriteria.description: Only a.txt is changed to exactly RC_A_DONE plus one newline, with a fresh successful read_file result obtained AFTER writing attached as criterion evidence.
